verdict.rationale: turbopuffer's docs say vector search keeps >90% recall when combined with any filters. The index is auto-tuned for 90-100% recall, a recall endpoint lets you verify this yourself, and exact kNN over a filtered subset is also supported. Filters also back attribute-based permission checks, and attributes can be marked filterable or not to tune indexing. missing for 10: documentation of filter operators and condition syntax, specific evidence on latency under selective filters, independent or hands-on corroboration of filtered recall.
